description:

Curious what it’s like to work at Iris? Head to this video for an inside look at the people, the passion, and the possibilities. Watch it here.
**Job Description**
-------------------


**Experience:** 7\-8 Years


**Location:** Gurugram


**Mandatory Skills:**


Automation Framework Creation for Testing, Continuous Integration (CI/CD), OOPS Concepts, Test Reporting \& Risk Management, Web Analytics Testing, Java, API Automation, Cucumber, Junit, Robot Framework, MS SQL


**Additional Skills:**


Playwright


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design and enhance scalable, extensible automation frameworks for UI, API, and mobile testing using Java/C\#/Python with strong OOPS and design principles.


* Lead UI automation and API testing initiatives using Playwright, Robot Framework, REST, and SOAP services to ensure comprehensive functional and integration test coverage.


* Define automation strategy including toolchain, framework architecture, and test coverage optimization across microservices and distributed systems.


* Implement advanced BDD/TDD practices to improve collaboration, traceability, and maintainability of test suites.


* Lead integration of automation with CI/CD (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI) and optimize pipelines for parallel execution and faster feedback.


* Own automation architecture and outcomes, including execution reliability, coverage effectiveness, and CI/CD feedback quality.


* Architect robust data\-driven and keyword\-driven frameworks with centralized reporting and analytics.


* Conduct thorough code reviews and enforce standards for XPath strategies, synchronization, and test stability.


* Drive database and API validation strategies ensure consistency across services and environments.


* Mentor engineers, conduct technical sessions, and uplift team capabilities in automation, frameworks, and best practices.


**Behavioral Competencies**


* Demonstrates ownership in driving quality initiatives and testing excellence.


* Collaborate effectively with teams and stakeholders for successful delivery.


* Apply strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to complex testing challenges.


* Communicates proactively to ensure stakeholder alignment and transparency.


* Mentors team members and promote knowledge sharing across testing practices.


* Ensures end\-to\-end quality delivery through effective test ownership.


* Drives innovation in testing strategies, processes, and automation adoption.


* Adapts effectively to changing requirements and testing priorities.


* Maintains attention to detail in testing, validation, and defect management.


* Takes initiative in improving test coverage, processes, and quality practices.


**Mandatory Competencies**

description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------



About this Opportunity

  

Join our team at Ericsson in the vital role of Automation Engineer (AE). The AE will automate tasks identified and outlined in the customer's managed services delivery scope, following approved requirements and the high\-level design (HLD) document. This pivotal role ensures the delivered automations function properly and meet the overall requirements and customer's expectations. The Software Developer supplies, to build a customer’s solution, in all phases of the software development lifecycle, towards accurately engineered information systems, containing software as the major component, to meet agreed business requirements! The Software Engineer is responsible for ensuring that the delivered software components provide the vital functionality and perform in accordance to the overall requirements and to the customer’s expectation!

  

You Will

  

 Involved in Solution Design, Development, and Integration.  

 Involved in Problem solving and critical thinking.  

 Deliver results \& meeting customer expectations.  

 Take Ownership of timely updates to all the affected partners regarding any new factors affecting any Automation application crafted or deployed or both.

  

  

To be successful in the role you are

  

 4\+ years’ experience in Java programming skills, Web technologies, knowledge and development experience, primarily on UNIX / Linux platform. software development experience in (Java, Groovy, JavaScript, extjs, Multithreading, JIRA).  

 Good solid understanding of packet networking. Development experience on this would be a definite plus.  

 Java programming skills, Web technologies, knowledge, and development experience, primarily on UNIX / Linux platform. software development experience in (Java, Groovy, JavaScript, extjs, Multithreading, JIRA)  

 Good to have \- knowledge and skills on any RDBMS, preferably on SQL.  

 Good solid understanding of packet networking. Development experience on this would be a definite plus.

 **All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.**

title: QA Automation Tester
description:
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a QA Automation Tester to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN\-UP), India (IN).
  
  

QE\- Automation \-
  
  

**Key responsibilities include:**  

* Overall Experience of 6\+ years in Automation Testing.
* Strong experience with Test Automation using BDD/Cucumber
* Skilled with API Test Automation
* Experienced with Front End Test Automation using Selenium
* Integrate automated tests into the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines to enable frequent and reliable releases.
* Evaluate requirements and define testing objectives and approaches while working in a global Agile Scrum team.
* Proactively seek opportunities to form partnerships with the customers and stakeholders to co\-create value for the company.
* Ensure the Test Conditions and Expected Results are complete and accurate.
* Demonstrable experience in tracking fixes and features in JIRA or similar configuration management tool.


Perform day\-to\-day automated functional testing activities to ensure that the current commitments are achieved while improvements are being made.
  
  

**Key Qualifications and Skills:**  

* Strong experience with Test Automation using BDD/Cucumber
* Experience with API Test Automation using Rest Assured, Swagger etc.
* Experienced with Front End Test Automation using Selenium
* Experience with creation and maintenance of Automation Framework
* Skilled in scripting/good knowledge and understanding with one of the following programming languages: Java, Java Script, Python etc.
* Good SQL knowledge.
* Experienced with Github/Gitlab
* Expertise in test planning, writing test cases/scripts
* Come up with test strategies and test plans for new and existing features
* Solid understanding and experience with agile software development methodologies and the practices derived from it.
* Derive test conditions and expected results from requirements user stories.


**QA:**  

Automation \- Playwright,
  
SQL

Testing React JS applications
  
CI/CD, Dev ops \- test integrations
  
Understanding of AI/ML testing concepts
  
should be able to write edge cases (negative, break cases)
